text:
maria_support: FYI customer reports invoice INV-2024-7839 PDF missing PO number. Portal shows PO=PO/ACME-98765 but PDF PO field is blank. Customer needs corrected PDF for AP to clear the payment. Attached screenshot in ticket.
jon_billing: Got it — can you confirm invoice id + account? Also need settlement state. If not settled we can void and reissue, if settled we'll do credit memo + corrected invoice. :thinking:
maria_support: INV-2024-7839, account: acme-enterprises (acct 7421). Payment shows as Paid (gateway ch_3KfX... settled 2024-10-12). Portal UI displays PO correctly in billing metadata.
invoice-bot: Invoice INV-2024-7839 marked paid via webhook at 2024-10-12T14:22:09Z
lee_eng: tagging eng. Quick theory: renderer sanitizer introduced last quarter strips characters like "/" which may cause template lookup to fail and render empty string. Can you paste exact PO from UI snapshot?
maria_support: copied value: "PO/ACME-98765". Customer says the printed PDF they received has the PO placeholder empty.
lee_eng: repro: ran internal pdf renderer locally with payload billing.metadata.po_number="PO/ACME-98765". The sanitizer in renderer runs .replace(/[^\w\-]/g,'') turning the string into "POACME98765"; then template logic attempts a sanitized key lookup and with certain edge cases returns empty which hides the field. Minimal repro cURL below:

curl -X POST https://internal-renderer.redwood.local/render \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"invoice_id":"INV-2024-7839","metadata":{"po_number":"PO/ACME-98765"}}'

Response produced PDF where text layer shows blank for PO field.
lee_eng: root cause nailed: aggressive sanitization for template metadata keys. Fix plan: skip sanitization for billing.metadata.* keys, add unit/regression test covering slashes, spaces, and non-alphanum. I'll open a patch and hotfix staging.
amy_ops: While eng works on code, what's the customer-facing remediation? jon, what's standard reissue/credit procedure for a settled invoice where PDF is incorrect but amounts are fine?
jon_billing: For settled invoice with incorrect PO text we typically: 1) create a credit memo (internal) that offsets the settled invoice 2) create a corrected invoice (same line items) with the PO corrected in metadata 3) apply credit memo so ledger nets zero for original 4) email corrected invoice + credit memo to customer with reconciliation note. If the customer insists on external refund + re-charge we can do a gateway refund then re-bill, but that takes longer. ETA: internal credit memo path = same day once finance approves; refund path = 1-3 business days.
maria_support: Customer wants corrected invoice + memo ASAP and prefers no refund if possible. Can we avoid refund since Stripe settlement is complete?
jon_billing: Yes — we can issue an internal credit memo (no external refund) and reissue corrected invoice. I'll file FIN ticket for approval.
lee_eng: Operational short-term fix: deploy renderer change to staging now, create a re-render endpoint so we can regenerate PDFs for affected invoices without issuing new invoice numbers. Then we'll run a job to re-render any invoices whose metadata.po_number contains non-alphanumeric chars. Will push to prod after QA (target within 4-6 hours).
invoice-bot: Re-render job queued for INV-2024-7839; job id 987; status: success; artifact: https://internal-storage.redwood.local/artifacts/INV-2024-7839-pdf-corrected.pdf
jon_billing: FIN ticket FIN-6152 created requesting approval for credit memo CM-2024-089 for INV-2024-7839. Assigning to @amy_ops for sign-off. I'll also prepare corrected invoice INV-2024-7839-R and the email draft for AP.
amy_ops: Approved FIN-6152 — proceed with internal credit memo CM-2024-089. Please ensure ledger note references invoice id and that PDFs are uploaded to the ticket. Also add an audit entry noting PDF re-rendered (no change to invoice number) to preserve trail.
jon_billing: Credit memo created and applied (CM-2024-089). Corrected invoice INV-2024-7839-R generated and PDFs uploaded to support ticket. Marked both docs in accounting system and linked to FIN-6152.
maria_support: Sent customer the corrected invoice PDF + credit memo with a short reconciliation note: "Please confirm PO field shows PO/ACME-98765 so AP can match." Customer replied: "Received — PO visible, thanks." Closing ticket.
lee_eng: follow-ups: backport renderer fix to stable branch, add regression tests, and add telemetry to detect empty rendered template fields so we can alert automatically. Filing ENG-9012.
amy_ops: Updating billing runbook in Confluence: added re-render step and audit requirements for regenerated PDFs and credit-memo flow for settled invoices.
maria_support: marking support ticket resolved. Thanks all for quick cross-team turnaround. :tada:
